primary: Observed risk-onset position AND onset time attribution
auxiliary: All observed onset-to-confirmation members inside, same onset-time support
extra_sensitivities: Historical all observed event to end
numerator: Confirmed original Stage0.2 core event, no local re-extraction; N_onset=sum 1{s_e in W} 1{x_e(s_e) in R}
denominator: E_R,W=sum h*1{original reliable same-follower/same-leader continuous link AND both endpoint status valid/not_applicable}*1{both follower endpoints in R AND full link in W}
rate: N / (E_R,W /3600), events per P2-evaluable following vehicle-hour
different_event_subtypes_share_standardi: Auxiliary rates are different attributed/subtype event intensities per the SAME evaluable local time, not estimates of an identical hazard; do not redefine denominator by event duration or eventual residence
